name: MindMemOS

paper.title: MindMemOS: A Portable and Self-Evolving Memory Operating Layer for AI Agents

construction.processing: LLM segments episodes, extracts schema entities/properties, fuses entities
construction.writer: LLM extractor guided by scenario schema (schema evolved by MindMemEvolve)

organization.structure: 3D entity-property-time graph with relation and timeline links
organization.stores: memory graph + archive; separate skill registry

management.conflicts: entity fusion expires outdated values; dreaming resolves conflicts with two LLM calls
management.forgetting: dreaming archives obsolete or redundant records

retrieval.query: LLM controller sets temporal scope, memory types, search queries
retrieval.candidates: BM25 + dense RRF with forward/reverse entity-property traversal
retrieval.selection: iterative plan; sufficiency check; temporal/relational expansion

stages.ingestion: MindVanilla groups messages into turns and token-bounded chunks with source references; MindSchema uses an LLM segmenter to cut the message stream into topic episodes.
stages.construction: MindVanilla extracts flat typed records (profile, fact, episodic, tool trace, experience, skill candidate) with recall-aware extraction; MindSchema maps each episode to schema-defined entities and first/higher-order properties with absolute timestamps, plus an episodic entity as fallback.
stages.organization: 3D entity-property-time memory graph: entities with relations, property timelines per entity-property pair; schema is scenario-adaptive.
stages.update: Deterministic gate maps candidates to Add/Reinforce/Update/Merge/Skip; entity fusion merges property timelines and expires outdated values; offline 'dreaming' clusters records per entity and uses two LLM calls to merge, resolve conflicts and archive; explicit/implicit user feedback triggers add/update/delete.
stages.retrieval: Compact search: an LLM controller plans iterative queries (temporal scope, memory types, sufficiency check) over an inner engine of BM25 + dense RRF with forward/reverse entity-property traversal and optional temporal/relational expansion.
stages.answer: Retrieved entity-centred memories are passed to the answer model (gpt-4.1-mini in the LoCoMo/PersonaMem evaluation).
stages.learning: MindMemEvolve: LLM-guided evolutionary search over memory schemas using judge-scored validation QA (no weight updates); MindSkillEvolve refines skills from execution trajectories.

summary: Memory layer built on an entity-property-time graph with schema-guided extraction, offline 'dreaming' consolidation, feedback-driven correction and evolutionary search over the memory schema itself.
notes:
AXES CORRECTED from the paper; earlier taxonomy row was: schema entry | rewritten | schema learning, dreaming | typed schema | feedback-driven (vector). Authors: Kaichao Liang et al. (MindMemOS Team, Noah's Ark Lab, Huawei). Two add policies: MindVanilla (schema-free) and MindSchema (schema-guided). GitHub README reports LoCoMo overall 93.64 for MindMemOS-schema, whereas the paper's Table 1 reports 94.03. AXES-CHECK: the seed taxonomy's selection 'feedback-driven (vector)' disagrees with the paper: selection is an LLM agentic planner over hybrid BM25+dense RRF with bidirectional graph traversal; feedback is a memory-maintenance (update) mechanism, not a selection mechanism. The seed taxonomy's 'schema learning' corresponds to MindMemEvolve (offline, validation-driven), which is only used for MindSchema.
DESIGN: Sec 2.2, 3.1-3.6, 4.1-4.2. Corrected: construction.processing was 'schema learning, dreaming' (dreaming is management; schema learning is offline MindMemEvolve). trigger 'other' = per memory-add request (async mode buffers until topic shift). use.reasoning null: answer procedure not described.
